newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore marine industry 1997 output seen steady.
newsitem.headline: Singapore marine industry 1997 output seen steady.

text.p: Singapore's marine industry is expected to maintain its output levels in 1997, the Economic Development Board (EDB) said on Thursday.
The EDB projected 1996 output of the marine industry, which encompasses ship repair, shipbuilding and maitenance along with jobs, at Singapore $3.14 billion.
"Expect flat output growth of the industry in 1997," the EDB said in a statement.
It said the key trends for the industry in 1997 included diversification into higher-valued activities, productivity upgrading and continued regionalisation.
